description: This file defines functions and types for generating an outline of Ginkgo test source files, including parsing AST nodes, managing hierarchical test structures, and outputting CSV or JSON representations.

classes.name: outline
classes.description: A struct holding a list of Ginkgo nodes representing the test outline.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes the outline nodes into JSON format.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a CSV-formatted string of the outline with no indentation.

methods.name: StringIndent
methods.description: Returns a CSV-formatted string of the outline with specified indentation per nesting level.
